title: Code of the District of Columbia, Title 32 (Labor), Chapter 5 - Leave from Work
verified_how: fetched https://code.dccouncil.gov/us/dc/council/code/titles/32/chapters/5: breadcrumb 'Title 32. Labor. / Chapter 5. Leave from Work.', listing 'Subchapter I. Family and Medical Leave. ss 32-501 - 32-517', 'Subchapter II. Parental Leave. ss 32-521.01 - 32-521.06', 'Subchapter III. Employee Sick Leave. ss 32-531.01 - 32-531.16', 'Subchapter IV. Universal Paid Leave. ss 32-541.01 - 32-541.12', 'Subchapter V. Universal Paid Leave Fund. ss 32-551.01 - 32-551.03' and 'Subchapter VI. Workplace Leave Navigators. [Repealed].'. Not marked '[Repealed]' or '[Not Funded]' (the register marks both inline, e.g. 'Chapter 5A. Freedom to Contract Within the Broadcast Industry. [Repealed]' in the same title). Currency: the Code's Publication Information block reads 'Current through Sept. 5, 2026', 'Last codified D.C. Law: Law 26-177 effective Sept. 5, 2026', 'Last codified Emergency Law: Act 26-416 effective Aug. 13, 2026', 'Last codified Federal Law: Public Law 115-334 approved Dec. 20, 2018'.
notes: One chapter carries the whole D.C. leave package: DC FMLA, parental leave, the Accrued Sick and Safe Leave Act and the Universal Paid Leave (paid family leave) programme. Subchapter VI is repealed; subchapters I-V are live. The old free-standing chapters 1A (Employee Sick Leave) and 12 (Parental Leave) are both flagged '[Recodified]' on the Title 32 list - they were folded into this chapter, so do not encode them separately.
